question: Which is the biggest tributary of the upper Brahmaputra that originates in the Tibetan Himalayas and winds its way into India through Arunachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subansiri.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subansiri **is the biggest tributary of the **upper Brahmaputra.**
 
• It originates in the** Tibetan Himalayas** and flows through **Arunachal Pradesh** before joining the **Brahmaputra in Assam.**
 
• The Brahmaputra River is one of the major rivers in Asia, flowing through **China, India, and Bangladesh.**
 
• It is also known as the **Tsangpo-Brahmaputra River** system.
 
• Some of the other tributaries of the Brahmaputra include the** Lohit, Dibang, and Kameng rivers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A tributary of the** Krishna River **is the** Yerala River.**

 
 
• It comes from the far north of **Khatav taluka in Satara district,** near the Mhaskoba highlands.
 
 
 
• The **Musi River** flows through **Telangana, India**, and is a significant tributary of the Krishna River in the Deccan Plateau.
 
 
• **Hyderabad** is located along the Musi River's banks.
 
 
 
• One of the rivers that flows through the T**apti River Basin** is the **Aner River.**
 
 
• It is situated in the Indian state of **Maharashtra**, close to Hisale.
 
 
 
• The Brahmaputra river basin is home to a diverse range of **flora and fauna**, including the endangered Gangetic dolphin and the one-horned rhinoceros.
 
• The Brahmaputra River is an important source of water for** irrigation, fishing, transportation, and hydropower generation** in the northeastern region of India.
